_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#2: conjugate heat transfer across two subdomains. Measured on skfem 12.0.1 (MeshQuad 17x5, with_subdomains fluid/solid, k=1 and k=100): the monolithic assembly shares the interface DOFs, so the interface temperature is single-valued to 1e-15; solving the two regions in isolation with insulated interfaces gives fluid 100.0 and solid 0.0 -- a jump equal to the FULL imposed temperature difference, exactly the O(1) failure the claim describes.
